field_rationales.category_specs.product_leave_in_fit_spec: Two persistent families support moderate residue potential. Paraffinum Liquidum does not identify the heavy mineral-oil grade required by the rich-band anchor. Low fails: Dimethicone r2 and mineral oil r3 persist. High is not established: no LGN pair and no confirmed heavy mineral-oil grade; do not invent viscosity. Evidence: Dimethicone r2: persistent silicone film, Paraffinum Liquidum r3: persistent nonvolatile emollient, No fatty-alcohol/cationic-surfactant pair. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. Mineral-oil viscosity/grade is not on INCI. High remains a possible alternate; targeted WT review required. The absence of a confirmed heavy grade is not proof of light mineral oil. fit_specs.weight mirrors specs.weight (medium). The silicone and mineral-oil package establishes ordinary leave-on conditioning without an LGN pair. Low fails: two persistent care families precede Phenoxyethanol r4. High fails: no LGN pair; extra slip observations do not upgrade COND. Evidence: Dimethicone r2: persistent silicone film, Paraffinum Liquidum r3: persistent nonvolatile emollient, No fatty-alcohol/cationic-surfactant pair, Polyacrylamide r7 + C13-14 Alkane r8 + Laureth-7 r11: plausible non-LGN emulsion rheology. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. Early marker r4 lowers confidence one step; it is plausible because both core care species precede it. Neutral silicone and mineral-oil deposits are the highest identified persistent mechanism class. Water-soluble/volatile-only fails on r2/r3. No amino silicone, silicone quat or polymeric quat is declared. Evidence: Dimethicone r2: persistent silicone film, Paraffinum Liquidum r3: persistent nonvolatile emollient. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. Early marker; Polyacrylamide family is unenumerated (§17.19), no cationic structure inferred. Polyacrylamide is plausibly the emulsion rheology polymer and no hold performance is inferred. Conditioning at r2/r3 dominates. A categorical none would hide the standard’s unenumerated Polyacrylamide family gap. Meaningful hold fails: conditioning dominates and no C1/C2 hold-led directions were captured. Evidence: Polyacrylamide r7 + C13-14 Alkane r8 + Laureth-7 r11: plausible non-LGN emulsion rheology. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. Polyacrylamide is explicitly unenumerated in §17.19; incidental is provisional and requires review. AD-3/AD-4: conditioning moderate + persistence moderate -> replacement_capable -> replacement_conditioner. styling_prep added: hold_support incidental, application_stage towel_dry, dry_hair. AD-3a fit mapping -> detangle_smooth.
